name: Necthan Scéne

attributes.attribute: killed the heroes who were sons of Necthan Scene

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Necthan Scene is an Irish heroine. She is an obscure figure and the mother of several heroes. Each of those heroes lost his life to the Ulster champion Cuchulainn.

okr.objective: Necthan Scene is an Irish heroine whose sons died at the hand of Cuchulain.
key_results: Necthan Scene is an Irish heroine.
She was the mother of several heroes.
All her sons lost their lives to the Ulster hero Cuchulain.
